d: Nitish setu pul ko bihar ke lie ek bara tohpha batane ke NDA ke dave par bihar vidhanasbha men vipaksh ke neta aur rashtriy janta dal (RJD) ke neta tejasvi yadav ne tikhi pratikriya di hai. midiya se batchit karte hue neta pratipaksh tejasvi yadav ne is pul ke nirman men kendr sarkar aur pradhanmantri narendr modi ke kisi bhi vittiy yogdan ke dave ko kharij karte hue dastaveji praman dikhane ki chunauti di hai.
